title: Admin consent
content:
# Admin consent

Get a Microsoft 365 administrator to approve Zernio once for the whole organization, so its users can connect their mailboxes.

Microsoft lets each organization decide who may approve apps that read mail, calendars, files and contacts. By default, many work and school tenants let only an administrator approve them. Personal Outlook.com accounts never need this.

## Before you start

You need a Microsoft account connected to a profile, and someone with an administrator role in that organization, such as Global Administrator, Cloud Application Administrator or Application Administrator.

## Approve Zernio for a whole organization

Request the admin-consent link for an account in that organization:

```bash
curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/connect/microsoft/admin-consent?accountId=ACCOUNT_ID&redirectUrl=https://example.com/admin-done" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY"
```

```json
{ "data": { "adminConsentUrl": "https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/adminconsent?client_id=…&state=…&redirect_uri=…" } }
```

Send `adminConsentUrl` to the administrator. They sign in, review the permissions and approve them for everyone in the organization.

Microsoft then sends them to `redirectUrl` with `adminConsent=granted` and `tenant` (the organization's tenant id), or with `adminConsent=denied` and `error`.

Once approved, calls that answered `412` `admin_consent_required` work without a reconnect.

## When to ask for it

- **A call answers `412` `admin_consent_required`.** `details.adminConsentUrl` is the Microsoft admin-consent link for that account, ready to send to an administrator. It opens in a browser without an API key and is valid for one hour; call the endpoint above for a fresh one or to set `redirectUrl`.
- **The user sees "Need admin approval" while connecting.** The organization blocks user consent, so the connect cannot finish. An administrator can connect their own mailbox first and tick "Consent on behalf of your organization" on Microsoft's screen, which approves Zernio for every user.

## How it behaves

- Approval is per organization, not per user. Every mailbox in the tenant can then connect without the prompt.
- The administrator approves the permissions of Zernio's app, which cover all four areas. Each user still chooses which areas their own connection grants.
- Zernio records the grant on the account (`tenant` and the time it was given).
- An administrator can withdraw the approval in Microsoft Entra, under Enterprise applications. Accounts in that tenant then fail until it is approved again.

## If it fails

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `adminConsent=denied` on the redirect | The administrator declined, or is not allowed to approve apps. `error` carries Microsoft's reason | Ask an administrator with an app-approval role. |
| `400` on `redirectUrl` | Not an absolute http(s) URL or app scheme | Pass a full URL. |
| `404` | The `accountId` does not exist or your key cannot reach it | List your accounts for a current id. |
